info.title: marksheet API
info.summary: The VTU scheme tables for the 2022 and 2025 regulations, as JSON.
info.description:
Every response is CORS enabled, and the metadata responses are cached for a day.

The scheme list, the grade scale, the branch list and the credit totals of each semester are open. The courses of a semester need a developer key or a calculator session. The whole scheme in one answer needs a key.

The data is the same set the [marksheet calculator](https://vtu.drshn.tech/calculator) uses: branch list, semester list, and every course with its code, title, credits and course type.

post.description:
Exchanges the token from the calculator page for a session id and a key. Every later answer for that session is encrypted with AES-GCM.

The token arrives in the `X-Marksheet-Page-Token` header and is issued by the calculator page. It is what separates the calculator from a script.

parameters.name: X-Marksheet-Page-Token
parameters.description: The signed page token from the calculator page.
